lines.text: Many learners say: He is more good than me.
Better: He is better than me.
Better! This phone is better than that one.

data.wrong: He is more good than me.

quiz.stem: This phone is ___ than that one.

native.tip: 中文说“更好”，就是“更”加“好”。英语里 good 有自己的特殊形式 better，不能说 more good。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He is more good than me.”😅 中文“更好”是“更”加“好”，英语要用 better：“He is better than me.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He is better than me.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese says “more good”, but English uses the special word better.
en.caption: Do you say “He is more good than me.” 😅 English uses the special word better: “He is better than me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
